Downloaded 2026-10-04. The original TTF is unmodified.
The artwork renders the four modern Hangul syllables 훈민정음 as fixed path outlines.
Only placement and scale are applied; this does not create a modified font.
The original font file is for regeneration and need not be served by the game.
